title: Rabbi Yose bar Yehudah of Kefar HaBavli

paragraphs: Rabbi Yose bar Yehuda, a man of Kefar HaBavli.

Avot 4:20 records his comparison: learning from the young is like eating unripe grapes and drinking wine fresh from the press; learning from elders is like eating ripe grapes and drinking aged wine. Rabbi disagrees: “Do not look at the jar, but at what it contains.”

notes.text: The repeated acronym asks the same comparison, and the numeral ך is 20. The contrast concerns the age of teachers, not the vessel’s appearance alone.
The characterization of Rabbi’s response as disagreement follows Hyman’s presentation of Avot 4:20.
